title: 找出可整除性得分最大的整数
summary: 除数的可整除性得分是 nums 中能被它整除的元素数，返回得分最大除数；平局取数值最小者。
insight: 直接枚举每个 divisor 并扫描 nums 计数。更新条件按 (score 更大) 或 (score 相同且 divisor 更小) 即可完整表达排序规则。
pitfalls: 除数数组可能不是有序的
平局比较除数本身而非下标

solutions.title: 枚举除数统计整除数
solutions.idea: 对每个候选独立计算得分。
steps: 若 count>bestScore 或平局且 divisor<answer，更新

code.java: class Solution { public int maxDivScore(int[] nums,int[] divisors){int bestScore=-1,answer=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int divisor:divisors){int score=0;for(int value:nums)if(value%divisor==0)score++;if(score>bestScore||score==bestScore&&divisor<answer){bestScore=score;answer=divisor;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxDivScore(nums:IntArray,divisors:IntArray):Int{var bestScore=-1;var answer=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(divisor in divisors){var score=0;for(value in nums)if(value%divisor==0)score++;if(score>bestScore||score==bestScore&&divisor<answer){bestScore=score;answer=divisor}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maxDivScore(vector<int>& nums,vector<int>& divisors){int bestScore=-1,answer=INT_MAX;for(int divisor:divisors){int score=0;for(int value:nums)score+=value%divisor==0;if(score>bestScore||(score==bestScore&&divisor<answer)){bestScore=score;answer=divisor;}}return answer;} };
